title: Created High-IQ with Elon - built w. Unity, ChatGPT + whisper rails. Generate your own mini-game (takes a few seconds), and compete with friends. Free beta on iOS & Android (link in comments)
author: _nidaz

comments.author: Maleficent_Bridge671
comments.body: Interesting! What types of games can you create?

replies.author: _nidaz
replies.body:
Right now, we have a couple of scripts running where users can create: Role playing games, crazy interviews, quiz shows, roast battles. A lot of experimenting at the moment. But they all include progression rails and point systems so users can compete in their creations.

The idea is to open up the script engine to developers to design their own mini-games at some point. Let me know if you have any requests and we can see what we can do!
